notes: User should visually page/filter the tray once in Play mode.

notes: Try at least two basic items manually.

check: x2, x3, x4, and vertical_3 items place stably.
method: Board placement validator over full roster.
notes: Manual pass should include each listed footprint.

check: Empty board battle leaves enemy HP unchanged, damages player HP, and ends in defeat.
method: Runtime loop preview built from an empty layout.

check: An attack item battle reduces enemy HP.
method: Runtime loop preview with attack item + energy support.
notes: Use an obvious attack item such as preview_fire_talisman or preview_thunder_sword.

check: Enemy attack consumes shield before HP.
method: Shield-item runtime loop enemy attack rows.

check: Heal, cleanse, control, aura, shield, and rhythm support rows do not damage enemy HP.
method: Per-item runtime loop previews for expected non-damage support IDs.
notes: Manual pass should include at least one heal/cleanse/control/energy item.

check: Sandbox victory, defeat, and restart result surfaces are present.
method: Runtime loop victory and empty-board defeat previews.

check: Switching test target can produce another playable preview.
method: Dev enemy scenario scan + restart/switch source scan.

check: Player side does not show complete answers, DropBias weights, or Boss six-key answers.
method: Scene text scan + runtime/player leak counters.

check: No SaveData, Reward, Chapter, or formal RunFlow is written or advanced.
method: Runtime formal leak counters + scene/layout write scan.
